title: dryopteris exstipellata
intro: Dryopteris exstipellata, commonly known as Chinese shield fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is a type of fern that has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, particularly in supporting respiratory and cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of D. exstipellata include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities, which may help to reduce inflammation, prevent infections, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of D. exstipellata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
